agentic_constraints.no_placeholders: CRITICAL: Do not produce mock code, dummy stubs, or empty TODO comments. All written code must be complete, typed, and executable.
agentic_constraints.tenant_isolation: CRITICAL: Every database query and cache lookup MUST include both workspaceId and userId. Cross-tenant leakage is a critical vulnerability.
agentic_constraints.credential_protection: CRITICAL: Never return API keys, passwords, or raw session cookies in API responses, logs, or UI renders. Model keys must be decrypted in memory only during outbound HTTP execution.
agentic_constraints.fail_closed_policy: Default to denying access or execution if permissions, actor identities, or verification proofs are missing or ambiguous.
agentic_constraints.tool_execution_safety: All terminal commands and external network mutations must be routed through the Permission Broker and execute inside isolated sandboxes.

risk_classification.R0: Read-only exploration, docs review, static analysis
risk_classification.R2: Shared package modifications (@safrs/*), database schema migrations, auth flows
risk_classification.R3: Production deployments, secret rotations, signed binary releases
